ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a root locus on the complex plane, with the horizontal axis as Re and the vertical axis as Im. The root locus consists of three straight-line branches intersecting at the origin and extending outward: one along the negative real-axis direction, i.e. 180° relative to the positive real axis; the other two extend respectively to the upper right and lower right, with directions approximately +60° and -60° relative to the positive real axis. The figure also uses a dashed line to mark the point (1, √3), indicating that the slope of the upper oblique line corresponds to tan 60°=√3. Reasoning: The problem statement indicates that the system is third order, so the root locus has three branches in total. The three branches are separated from one another by 120°, with directions 180°, +60°, and -60°, which exactly matches the root-locus asymptote angles when there are no finite zeros and there are three excess open-loop poles. Since all three branches start from the origin, it can be judged that the three open-loop poles are all located at s=0. Therefore the denominator of the open-loop transfer function is s^3, and there is no finite zero factor, so the open-loop transfer function is G(s)=K/s^3.

raw_record.question_text: The figure shows the root locus plot (location of poles not given) of a third-order system whose open-loop transfer function is ______.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the locus consists of three straight branches meeting at the origin, with directions 180° and ±60° from the positive real axis. Use the text statement that the system is third order. The three equally spaced branches match the root-locus asymptotes for three excess poles and no finite zeros. Since the branches originate at the origin, place all three open-loop poles at s=0. Therefore the open-loop transfer function has denominator s^3 and no numerator zero factor, so it is G(s)=K/s^3.

推理：题干说明系统为三阶，因此根轨迹共有三条分支。三条分支彼此相隔 120°，方向为 180°、+60°、-60°，这正符合没有有限零点、且有三个多余开环极点时的根轨迹渐近线角度。由于三条分支都从原点出发，可判断三个开环极点都位于 s=0。因此开环传递函数分母为 s^3，且无有限零点因子，故开环传递函数为 G(s)=K/s^3。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: all possible pole locations lie on three rays from the origin at angles 60°, 180°, and 300°, with the dashed guide showing the upper ray through (1,√3). Let a point on the locus be s=re^{jθ}. For θ=60°, 180°, or 300°, s^3=r^3e^{j3θ}=r^3e^{j180°}=-r^3, a negative real number. Thus the closed-loop equation can be written s^3+K=0 as K varies positively. Comparing with 1+G(s)=0 gives G(s)=K/s^3.
